title: Granges Powder Metallurgy AM material datasheet AlSi10Mg, 50 micrometre layer, revision 09.2022
notes: Downloaded and read as text on 2026-11-12 (SHA-256 of the file read: edcb036c1ca20c23a0a4cc56f8046c796fad950caa4b19c1f48954fd24e89546; the file is not stored). Powder supplier sheet for 50 micrometre layers. Powder weight fraction above 90 micrometres: 0.3 wt.%. Roughness as manufactured on vertical surfaces: Ra 11 to 20 micrometres and Rz 70 to 170 micrometres, given as an indication and said to depend on orientation and layer thickness. The machine is not named. The sheet states no dimensional accuracy, no minimum wall or feature and no radius.
